result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks but lacks robust crossing infrastructure, with existing crosswalk markings being significantly faded. The absence of active traffic control or signage at this intersection, combined with potential sightline obstructions from parked cars, creates a moderate risk for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are severely worn and barely visible to approaching motorists, reducing the likelihood of driver yielding.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signs to alert drivers of the crossing location and reinforce right-of-way.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a sidewalk and a marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection adjacent to a commercial area. While basic infrastructure is present, the crosswalk markings are faded and there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signaling or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse lines marking the crosswalk are worn and may not be highly visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present for vehicles, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide safe crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corner to shorten the crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks, though the markings are significantly faded. The presence of a large residential building suggests high pedestrian demand, yet the roadway surface is cracked and the crossing lacks high-visibility enhancements or physical protection.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the asphalt within the intersection area could pose a tripping hazard or affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, safe surface for all users.
